text:
maria: kicking off canary for voice-service v2 in eu-west1 — 10% traffic, scheduled 30m window. watching logs + dash.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by @maria | service=voice-service | image=redwood/voice:2.1.0 | canary=10% | region=eu-west1 | id=dep-2156789012

kevin: on it. i'll watch 95p latency and error-rate. will flag if >1% errors or 95p >1200ms.

anjali: FYI ops runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/escape-voice - follow the "fast rollback" checklist if we hit thresholds.

sanjay: +1. quick reminder: if we need to pin to previous image do not use rolling update on replicas, use the rollback command in runbook to avoid cache eviction.

kevin: copying the rollback snippet here for visibility:
``` 
# rollback to last known-good
./opsctl rollback --service voice-service --to-tag redwood/voice:2.0.7 --region eu-west1 
# or for k8s: kubectl -n prod set image deploy/voice-deploy voice=redwood/voice:2.0.7
```

maria: thanks. ops-runbook-bot — confirm we have the canary safeguards enabled (auto-undo on spike, incremental scaling).

ops-runbook-bot: Safeguards active: auto-undo thresholds set (error_rate=1%, p95_latency=1200ms), incremental promote schedule=10%->30%->60%->100% (manual hold at each step).

kevin: seeing a small uptick in 5xxs in one pod, ~0.4% overall, digging into logs.

anjali: if it localizes to a pod, prefer draining and redeploying that instance rather than full rollback. runbook section: "pod-isolation-first".

maria: canary hold at 10% while we triage. tagging the escalation channel #eng-oncall. @sanjay if you need the escape hatch, give the thumbs up. :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:

sanjay: Give me 5 mins to confirm. quick note — CS contact already prepped per runbook (notify-cs=true).

kevin: root cause looks like a malformed protobuf in an edge request; spike limited to EU region edge. rate should drop once faulty client is blocked.

maria: ok holding. if errors cross 1% in next 3min -> execute rollback command above. otherwise promote to 30%.

deploy-bot: Canary progress snapshot | canary=10% | errors=0.6% | p95=980ms | active=3 pods | time=00:04:27

anjali: documenting decision: not rolling back now, pod-level restart if error persists. adding note to release notes draft.

maria: thanks team. will update after next snapshot.

deploy-bot: Canary progress snapshot | canary=10% | errors=0.3% | p95=860ms | active=3 pods | time=00:09:38

kevin: looks stable. moving to promote to 30% in 2m. will keep watch.

maria: promote when ready. leave the runbook link in the release notes and tag the escape-hatch steps we used.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook excerpt added to thread: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/escape-voice#fast-rollback (checklist copied to release doc).
